name: propose_variable
description: Stage a new variable proposal for the customer to review before committing anything -- does NOT create it yet. Shows up in review_plan's staged_ops list; edit it with revise_plan, remove it with revise_plan(remove=true), or commit every staged item (this and any others) at once with apply_plan. params must match variable_op's own input_schema for a create operation (type, name, etc.) -- 'operation' itself is set automatically to "create" and must not be included.

params.description: Same shape as variable_op's create arguments (type, name, prec, etc., but never 'operation') -- see that tool's own description for the full grammar.
